message: No detected input validation: The code reads the Excel file directly with pd.read_excel and selects columns by name, but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local file path supplied via command-line argument; there is no remote source fetching, and no checksum or integrity verification of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code only reads the Excel file and filters columns; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps applied to the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The Predictor class loads models from file via load_model_from_file without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision validation visible in this code.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no check for class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous samples before or during training in any of the code paths.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection is present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any custom adversarial stress-test logic anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: No held-out test set isolation, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics is implemented; evaluation results are simply logged and written to an output file without integrity controls.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads the Excel file and passes data directly to filter_data and then to the predictor without any shape, range, type, or schema validation on the input data.

No detected output bounds checks: Predictions from predictor.make_predictions() are stored and returned directly via get_results() with no NaN checks, probability bounds validation, or sanity checks on the output values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a classical ML model (LinearSVC) operating on tabular clinical/imaging data, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
